MORNING: Last night's dishes into the sink
Put keys, wallet and phone in their spot
NIGHT: Set a 5‑minute timer and grab stray stuff
Every cup and plate to the kitchen
Start the dishwasher or soak the pans

Kitchen: Toss 3 old things from the fridge
Put away 5 things on the counter
Bedroom: Pick up clothes off the floor
Bring stray cups to the kitchen
Living room: Fold the blanket, fluff the pillows
Laundry: Move the wet load to the dryer
Anywhere: Carry one armful back where it belongs
Put on one song and tidy until it ends

MICRO: Put ONE dish in the sink
Pick up ONE thing off the floor
Put ONE thing back where it lives
Wipe ONE spot with a paper towel
Close ONE open drawer or cabinet
Put ONE piece of clothing in the hamper
Stand up, stretch, grab ONE cup
